violations.text: The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Part needed has been ordered to repair dishwasher and is expected early next week. Facility will continue to use paper products for residents. All cookware and cooking utensils will be sanitized using the 3-bay sink. Proper concentration observed via test strip. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2026

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit (rinse temperature of 180 degrees F) was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Service call placed. 3-bay sink is to be used to sanitize until dishwasher is serviced and achieving proper sanitizing temperature. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener was washed, rinsed, and sanitized during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2026

1-door reach-in was observed held at 55 degrees Fahrenheit. Foods in this unit observed with temperatures of 45 - 46 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods in this unit had just been delivered (2 hours prior to inspection) and were relocated to properly functioning units. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2026

ROP crabmeat observed thawing in the walk-in cooler in its original packaging. ROP foods must be removed from packaging when thawing to allow oxygen to enter for food safety. Crabmeat observed with a temperature of 36 degrees F and was removed from packaging. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2026
